data_section_full_text:
All companies eligible to be on the MA list are from the Fortune 1000; thus, we limit our
sample to the Fortune 1000 companies. This yields 13,875 company-year observations identifiable in COMPUSTAT from 1995 through 2009. <sup>15</sup> We omit observations lacking the
data necessary to calculate variables in our basic misstatement model. Specifically, we
eliminate 2,786 observations without the daily stock price data necessary to calculate stock
return volatility and 2,070 observations for which we cannot calculate CEO tenure. We
also eliminate 812 observations lacking information about foreign sales or segment sales.
Finally, we eliminate 126 observations that lack other COMPUSTAT data items used to
calculate our main variables in model 1. Our final sample consists of 8,081 company-year
observations.
